title: SUPPLY CHAIN ANALYTICS
description: Supply chain management, model design of a supply chain network, inventories, stock systems, commonly used inventory models, supply contracts, value of information and information sharing, risk pooling, design for postponement, managing product variety, information technology and supply chain management; international and environmental issues. Note: replaced IEOR E4000 beginning in fall 2018.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: IEOR E3402 or instructor's permission.
